summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) implementing a full writable sharing flow: API backend, owner UI for permission toggling, and recipient UI for write actions in SharedFileBrowser.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed successfully. A critical bug was discovered and fixed during UAT: files uploaded through shared folders lacked per-file IPNS records, making them unreadable. The fix creates proper IPNS metadata during shared uploads and adds fallback decryption paths.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout from cipher-box; .env files must be copied manually from ../cipher-box/ — they are not shared or symlinked
cipher-box-ci-debug requires packages to be built before the web dev server can start (@cipherbox/sdk, sdk-core, core must be built in dependency order)
Web app falls back to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is unset, which points to the wrong port (5173 instead of 3000)
The addShareKeys API endpoint previously only allowed share owners to add keys; write-share recipients also need this permission to add share_keys for files they upload
Shared folder uploads set fileMetaIpnsName: '' (line 807 of useSharedNavigation.ts) — a PoC shortcut that skips per-file IPNS record creation, breaking file retrieval
ReceivedShare entity includes sharerPublicKey, enabling recipients to wrap file keys for the owner during shared uploads
OTP codes are visible in API server logs and can be retrieved from the console output

code.finding: Shared upload set fileMetaIpnsName: '' as a PoC shortcut — root cause of the IPNS-not-available error for files uploaded via shared folders

Check for item.fileMetaIpnsName before attempting to open file — throws 'legacy v1 file?' error for shared-upload files without IPNS records; updated with fallback to fileKeyEncrypted from file metadata
downloadSharedFile throws if no share_key found; needs fallback to fileKeyEncrypted from file metadata for files uploaded before the fix
addShareKeys authorization relaxed to allow write-share recipients (in addition to owners) to add keys to their own share
batchPublishIpnsRecords accepts a recordType field and is the correct function for batch IPNS publishing during file uploads

workflow: Background tasks spawned by the Claude Code runtime are killed when the conversation context shifts — use detached processes (nohup/disown) for dev servers that need to persist across tool calls
API client must be regenerated after controller changes; the codegen produces warnings but no errors is acceptable
TypeScript check (tsc --noEmit) is a fast way to validate changes before committing in a monorepo without running the full build

friction: cipher-box-ci-debug had no .env files, requiring manual copy from the sibling cipher-box repo — caused multiple failed API server starts
PostgreSQL host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring .env creation from scratch
Background tasks were repeatedly killed by the Claude Code runtime when conversation context shifted, requiring 4+ server restart cycles
git lock file was stale and blocked commits, requiring manual removal
Web dev server failed on first start because SDK packages hadn't been built — build order (core → sdk-core → sdk) was not documented
open_items: Fallback decryption in TextEditorDialog and downloadSharedFile handles files uploaded before the fix (no share_key), but this is a transitional concern — could be cleaned up once all shares are migrated
The API client regeneration after controller changes should be automated as part of the build/dev workflow
Shared upload now creates per-file IPNS records but the full UAT for file read/edit/download in shared folders was not completed after the fix — needs re-verification
